description: This file is a shell script for testing git merge-base performance and correctness. It creates complex commit histories with multiple merges, runs git commands like 'git merge-base' and 'git show-branch', and verifies the results.

methods.name: build_history
methods.description: Creates a commit history with a specified depth with merges, used for testing git merge-base performance.

methods.name: build_history2
methods.description: Creates an alternative commit history with the same root commits and additional merges, used to test multiple merge bases.
